name: Wankstüberl
kurzbeschreibung:
**Wankstüberl in Tirol**

Discover the cozy charm of the **Wankstüberl**, a traditional alpine hut nestled in the heart of **Tirol**. Perched at an elevation of 1,200 meters, this rustic retreat offers breathtaking views of the **Kaisergebirge** and the **Zillertal Alps**.

Indulge in hearty **Tiroler** specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Käsespätzle**, and **Schweinsbraten**—all served with a side of warm hospitality. Whether you're hiking the **Wank** or simply unwinding with a **Schnaps** by the fireplace, the **Wankstüberl** promises an authentic taste of **Tirol’s** alpine culture.

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this hidden gem is the perfect stop for nature lovers and food enthusiasts alike. Come experience the warmth of **Tirol** at the **Wankstüberl**!
